ingredients.tip: Spoon and level for a tender crumb

ingredients.text: Maple syrup and berries, to serve

steps.text: Whisk the flour, sesame, sugar, baking powder, and a pinch of salt.
Beat the milk, egg, and melted butter, then fold into the dry mix just until streak-free.
Rest the batter so the flour hydrates and the pancakes cook evenly.
Cook small rounds in a buttered skillet until bubbles set at the edges, then flip.
Stack high and finish with berries, maple syrup, and a final scatter of sesame.
